key_points: Imaging techniques used for diagnosis of peripheral artery disease (PAD) include MR angiography, CT angiography, and ultrasound.
Patients with PAD have a high prevalence of cardiovascular and limb-related risks.
Major limb outcomes are worse in patients with diabetes and PAD.
Elderly patients with PAD have an increased risk of complications such as amputations.
Controlling tobacco use, antiplatelets, and lipid-lowering therapies are essential in management.
